useCases.title: Build a free chatbot for a side project
useCases.summary: Stream anyrouter/free replies with the AI SDK
useCases.problem: A demo chatbot dies the day its one free model gets rate-limited, and a paid key on a public page is a bill waiting to happen.

snippets.title: streamText

snippets.code:
curl https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANYROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "anyrouter/free",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Say hello in one sentence." }]
  }'
snippets.title: curl · anyrouter/free

steps: Create a key and keep it on your server. Go ($2/mo) or a donated key gets you paid-model access.
npm install @anyr/ai-sdk-provider ai, then stream with anyrouter/free.
Read the model field in the response or Dashboard → Logs to see which free model answered.
